notes: 🏰 Tower Defense: troops now have very different ranges (Frost short, Cannon short-medium, Archer long, Ballista very long), and you can build anywhere up to 3 squares from the road. 🏰 Tower Defense, bigger and darker: a big night-time map (roads about 90 squares long, room for whole teams) with pine trees, dead trees, rocks, glowing mushrooms and fireflies. Every troop now hits groups — archer volleys, bigger cannon blasts, frost novas and ballista bolts that pierce a whole line. A warning before every boss wave, and a brand-new game-style lobby.
